blocks.text:
Lists are intended to be used whenever developers want to display many objects
in roughly the same way. They are perfectly fine to be used for very short lists
of only 2 or 3 items, but generally scale fine to thousands of items.
blocks.zh: 凡是想以大致相同的方式展示大量对象时，都适合用列表——极短的列表也完全没问题。

blocks.text:
Lists are meant to be used with changing data, both with the items themselves
changing as well as the list adding and removing items. Of course, they work just
as well with static data.
blocks.zh: 列表为「会变化的数据」而生：无论是条目自身内容变化，还是列表增删条目，都能胜任；静态数据同样工作正常。

blocks.text:
The [List Widget Overview](https://docs.gtk.org/gtk4/section-list-widget.html)
chapter in the GTK documentation contains more information about list widgets.
blocks.zh: GTK 文档的「List Widget Overview」一章包含关于列表控件的更多信息。

blocks.text:
Some examples are shown in this chapter. There are more examples in the
[listmodelviews directory](https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gtkmm-documentation/tree/&url_examples_branch;/examples/book/listmodelviews/)
in `gtkmm-documentation`'s examples.
blocks.zh: 本章展示了若干示例；gtkmm-documentation 仓库的 listmodelviews 目录里还有更多。

blocks.text:
The data model is a class that implements the `Gio::ListModel`
interface. Examples of such classes are `Gio::ListStore`
(not to be confused with the deprecated `Gtk::ListStore`),
`Gtk:StringList`, `Gtk:DirectoryList`
and `Pango::FontMap`.
blocks.zh: 数据模型是实现 `Gio::ListModel` 接口的类。这类类的例子有 `Gio::ListStore`（不要与已弃用的 `Gtk::ListStore` 混淆）、`Gtk::StringList`、`Gtk::DirectoryList` 与 `Pango::FontMap`。

blocks.text:

blocks.text:
Every item in a model has a position which is the unsigned integer that describes
where in the model the item is located. The first item in a model is at position 0.
The position of an item can of course change as other items are added to or removed
from the model.
blocks.zh: 模型中的每个条目都有一个位置（position）：一个无符号整数，描述条目位于模型何处。模型的第一个条目位于位置 0。当然，随着其他条目被加入或移除，条目的位置也会变化。
